'''Randy Michista Imperial Beatdown''' is a [[Dark]] deck by [[Randy Michista]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ds60.htm Imperial Beatdown], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]).
